program.name: residual_lower
program.rationale: Prioritize a feasible residual completion, with a modest upper-bound bonus. Neighbor and residual structure can separate equal-degree witnesses, including joins with identical neighbor edge counts.

program.name: local_exchange
program.rationale: Estimate reward per displaced feasible neighbor packing rather than per neighbor count. Normalized residual capacity and edge density may transfer between sparse temporal graphs and dense conflict graphs.

program.name: residual_upper
program.rationale: Favor optimistic conditional completion capacity for include-first branching. A small packing-gap discount and structural corrections retain information when clique-cover bounds tie or are loose.

program.name: gap_adaptive
program.rule: weight + r_pack + (0.10 if station_gap+satellite_gap > 0 else 0.50)*(r_cover-r_pack) - (0.25 if station_gap+satellite_gap > 0 else 0.10)*n_pack - 0.05*(n_cover-n_pack) + 0.01*n_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1+degree)) - 0.01*r_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1+compatible_weight))
program.rationale: Tighter gaps may justify trusting feasible residual packing more strongly and charging more for displaced neighbor opportunities. Structural features remain active on both sides of the constraint switch.

program.name: closed_opportunity
program.rationale: Measure alternatives within the closed neighborhood against the root reward. Closed-neighborhood packing and partition summaries offer a different structural interface while residual edges distinguish externally asymmetric joins.

program.name: saturated_bounds
program.rationale: Cap completion-bound bonuses at the root reward so loose covers cannot dominate. Weighted edge summaries preserve the unit-weight structural distinctions and extend the hypothesis to unequal rewards.

program.name: boundary_release
program.rationale: Count conflicts between removed neighbors and the surviving residual graph. Removing neighbors with many external conflicts may release substantial compatibility even when their internal structure and base features match.

program.name: exclusion_margin
program.rationale: Compare polynomial inclusion and exclusion summaries to estimate the marginal value of retaining the root. This uncertain hypothesis may expose distinctions hidden by neighbor summaries alone.

program.name: pack_continuation
program.rationale: Prioritize a feasible include continuation, with modest upper-bound guidance and penalties for feasible blocked alternatives and residual congestion.

program.name: edge_floor
program.rationale: Combine a greedy continuation with the weight-minus-edge-deletion lower bound, retaining modest clique-bound optimism and rewarding redundancy among blocked conflicts.

program.name: gap_adaptive_blend
program.rationale: Hypothesize that positive resource gaps warrant less bound optimism and stronger blocked-packing penalties, while continuation and conflict structure remain the primary signals.

program.name: cover_optimism
program.rationale: Use the residual clique bound as an optimistic objective, tempered by greedy disagreement and blocked opportunities; boundary conflicts may make those alternatives less attractive.

program.name: conflict_ratio
program.rationale: Score preserved continuation per unit of blocked independent opportunity; dense neighbor conflicts and boundary edges suggest redundant or externally costly alternatives.

program.name: harmonic_potential
program.rationale: Use harmonic combinations to limit the influence of loose clique bounds on continuation and blocked opportunity; weighted edge products distinguish redundancy from residual congestion.

program.name: marginal_regret
program.rationale: Estimate include-versus-exclude marginal value from both feasible packings and clique bounds, using blocked packing and neighborhood closure to distinguish similar regrets.

program.name: interval_dominance
program.rationale: Compare an include lower estimate against an exclude upper estimate, then mix the opposite interval margin; neighborhood and boundary conflicts resolve broad bound ties.

program.name: interval_completion
program.rationale: Blend feasible residual packing and its clique-cover bound, discount independent alternatives destroyed by inclusion, and retain both neighborhood and residual edge witnesses for equal Base9 joins.

program.name: clustered_opportunities
program.rationale: Sparse neighborhoods may contain several mutually compatible alternatives, so inclusion receives a larger opportunity-cost penalty there. Residual packing, cover, and edges address ties with identical local density.

program.name: residual_density
program.rationale: A density surrogate favors numerous compatible actions with fewer surviving conflicts. Boundary exposure supplies information beyond internal neighborhood edges, while global density adjusts the degree penalty.

program.name: weighted_boundary_relief
program.rationale: Weighted boundary conflicts proxy pressure released when the neighborhood is removed. Balance that relief against feasible lost alternatives and surviving conflict mass, extending edge-count witnesses to weighted active graphs.

program.name: uncertainty_adaptive
program.rationale: Prefer demonstrated residual packing and penalize residual bound looseness relative to the whole graph's packing-cover gap. Resource gaps increase the opportunity-cost penalty, while edge witnesses retain local structural distinctions.

program.name: force_forbid_margin
program.rationale: Compare polynomial completion summaries after forcing the root with those after excluding it. Packing and cover margins offer different structural witnesses, with edge corrections resolving some equal-size completions.

program.name: economical_edge_pack
program.rationale: Use three inexpensive edge summaries, two greedy packings, and one cover bound. Recover boundary exposure directly in the rule and preserve a weighted-degree preference alongside residual completion evidence.

program.name: packed_edge_witness
program.rationale: For unit graphs, scaling integer packing by active-set size squared and subtracting induced edges preserves both summaries at fixed size. This carries eight structural summaries in six demanded features and combines them with exclusion context.

program.name: feasible_completion
program.rationale: Prioritize a feasible completion after inclusion, with a small cover contribution and local conflict corrections for structural ties.

program.name: cover_completion
program.rationale: Favor residual upper capacity while checking feasible support and whether adding the root changes closed-neighborhood packing capacity.

program.name: clique_cost_ratio
program.rationale: Estimate lost independent neighbor reward rather than summing all conflicts, then use normalized residual capacity and weighted edge redundancy.

program.name: density_adaptive
program.rationale: Use completion estimates more strongly in dense active graphs and emphasize independent neighborhood cost in sparse graphs.

program.name: boundary_credit
program.rationale: Credit removing neighbors that also constrain surviving actions, while accounting for mutually conflicting alternatives and residual completion.

program.name: gap_cautious
program.rationale: Test a conservative completion hypothesis that penalizes large cover-versus-packing gaps, with stronger caution as temporal gaps grow.

program.name: weighted_edge_relief
program.rationale: Reward removal of conflicts among heavy actions and penalize weighted conflict pressure remaining after inclusion.

program.name: feasible_continuation
program.rationale: Prioritize feasible forced reward with modest continuation optimism, discounted neighbor alternatives, and small edge corrections.

program.name: density_objective
program.rationale: Blend feasible and upper continuation summaries with a density surrogate motivated by the unit-weight examples; weighted transfer remains a hypothesis.

program.name: include_exclude_margin
program.rationale: Contrast polynomial inclusion and exclusion summaries, blending a conservative margin with an optimistic margin and local opportunity cost.

program.name: uncertainty_discount
program.rationale: Favor reliable continuation under tighter gaps while rewarding compressed conflicts and removal of neighbors that constrain the residual.

program.name: closed_local_regret
program.rationale: Penalize forcing a root when its closed neighborhood supports a better local packing, while retaining projected residual reward.

program.name: opportunity_ratio
program.rationale: Normalize projected forced reward by feasible and upper neighbor opportunity, with boundary relief and temporal cost corrections.

program.name: global_gap_switch
program.rationale: Use feasible continuation when global packing and cover agree; otherwise admit more upper-bound guidance for unresolved structure.

program.name: include_exclude_envelope
program.rationale: Rank inclusion by a conservative and optimistic advantage envelope against polynomial exclusion summaries.

program.name: residual_consensus
program.rationale: Combines feasible residual packing with a modest upper-summary contribution. Neighborhood and residual structure may distinguish joins that collide on base features or neighborhood edge counts.

program.name: cover_boundary_loss
program.rationale: Discounts optimistic residual cover by its packing gap and charges neighborhood opportunity cost. Boundary edges expose how removed neighbors interact with the remaining graph.

program.name: density_adaptation
program.rationale: Hypothesizes that sparse active graphs favor reliable packing while denser graphs benefit from residual cover information. The switch uses current density and constraint gaps without source lookup.

program.name: bounded_regret_bridge
program.rationale: Allow continuation optimism bounded by the exclusion gap, penalize observed feasible exclusion advantage, and credit boundary relief.

program.name: neighbor_exchange
program.rationale: Emphasizes root reward relative to a feasible competing neighborhood packing. Residual completion and neighborhood redundancy temper the local exchange estimate.

program.name: completion_margin
program.rationale: Tests polynomial inclusion-versus-exclusion margins as an opportunity-cost estimate. Residual and neighborhood edge summaries provide distinctions beyond packing and cover totals.

program.name: boundary_relief
program.rationale: Tests whether removing heavily interconnected neighbors yields useful conflict relief. Feasible neighborhood opportunity cost and residual completion prevent edge relief from being the sole priority.

program.name: residual_floor
program.rationale: Combines greedy residual packing with a weighted edge-deletion floor and limits optimism from the cover gap. The floor retains residual edge distinctions in unit-weight examples while extending to weighted graphs.

program.name: conservative_margin
program.rationale: Favors agreement between inclusion-versus-exclusion packing and cover margins, penalizing disagreement in their gaps. This is a conservative heuristic rather than a certified conditional bound.

program.name: packing_interval_margin
program.rationale: Hypothesis: realized residual packing predicts preferred completions, while packing-cover disagreement and independently selectable excluded neighbors measure uncertainty and opportunity cost.

program.name: cover_clustering
program.rationale: Hypothesis: clique-aware residual capacity can recover preferences obscured by greedy tie choices; closed-neighborhood cover changes distinguish how the root participates in conflict clusters.

program.name: boundary_relief
program.rationale: Hypothesis: excluding neighbors that conflict heavily with the residual releases more compatibility than degree alone indicates; internal neighbor conflicts reduce the effective exclusion cost.

program.name: gap_adaptive_completion
program.rationale: Hypothesis: positive separation gaps justify stronger attention to residual capacity and clustered conflicts, while zero-gap states can rely more heavily on realized residual packing.

program.name: conditional_regret
program.rationale: Hypothesis: polynomial inclusion-versus-deletion contrasts approximate conditional regret and distinguish candidates whose equal degree hides different alternative completions.

program.name: joint_capacity_profiles
program.rationale: Hypothesis: size-scaled joint packing and cover profiles preserve several relational distinctions within six features, with clustering and deletion alternatives refining the packing-led priority.

program.name: weighted_boundary_exchange
program.rationale: Hypothesis: endpoint-minimum edge weights estimate the reward involved in residual conflicts and boundary exchanges, extending conflict-clustering preferences to heterogeneous rewards.

program.name: forced_packing
program.rationale: Prioritize feasible reward after forcing the action, with smaller corrections for discarded independent alternatives, neighborhood redundancy, and residual conflict.

program.name: edge_density_penalty
program.rule: weight - conflict_weight / max(1e-9, abs(1 + 2 * neighbor_edge_count / max(1e-9, abs(1 + neighbor_count)) + neighbor_edge_min / max(1e-9, abs(conflict_weight)))) - residual_edge_product / max(1e-9, abs(residual_mass * (1 + residual_count)))
program.rationale: Test an inexpensive objective that discounts removed neighbor weight when neighbors conflict mutually, then penalizes normalized weighted edge pressure in the forced residual.

program.name: closed_redundancy
program.rule: weight - closed_lower + (closed_mass - closed_upper) / max(1e-9, abs(1 + closed_count)) + closed_edge_min / max(1e-9, abs(1 + closed_edge_count)) - (closed_upper - closed_lower) / max(1e-9, abs(1 + closed_count))
program.rationale: Credit mutually exclusive mass in the closed neighborhood while charging local feasible packing and bound disagreement. Average edge redundancy supplies a second compression signal.

program.name: forced_cover
program.rationale: Favor optimistic residual capacity while discounting disagreement with feasible packing. Neighborhood and residual edge summaries provide smaller structural corrections.

program.name: gap_envelope
program.rationale: Hypothesize that stronger separation constraints warrant a larger discount on speculative residual capacity, alongside neighborhood opportunity cost and conflict redundancy.

program.name: clipped_completion_regret
program.rationale: Hypothesis: deletion-state packing uncertainty can calibrate an optimistic residual estimate, while clipping and exclusion-regret penalties prevent loose capacity summaries from dominating preferred relations.

program.name: opportunity_ratio
program.rationale: Rank immediate reward relative to independently usable neighbor reward, then use residual capacity and closed-neighborhood scarcity as smaller corrections.

program.name: gap_aversion
program.rule: weight + residual_lower - max(0, residual_upper - residual_lower) * (1 + 2 * residual_edge_count / max(1e-9, abs(residual_count * (1 + residual_count))) + residual_edge_min / max(1e-9, abs(residual_mass * (1 + residual_count))))
program.rationale: Test uncertainty aversion beyond feasible forced reward: penalize the residual cover-versus-packing gap more strongly when residual edge density and weighted conflict density increase.

program.name: residual_blend
program.rationale: Blend feasible and optimistic residual completion estimates. Neighborhood capacity measures exclusion cost, while residual edges can distinguish joins whose neighborhoods have identical edge counts.

program.name: gap_density_adaptive
program.rule: weight + (0.65*residual_greedy + 0.35*residual_cover if station_gap+satellite_gap>0 else 0.9*residual_greedy + 0.1*residual_cover) - 0.04*neighbor_greedy + (0.02 if degree*2>remaining_count else 0.005)*neighbor_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1+degree)) - 0.02*residual_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1+total_edges))
program.rationale: Test stronger optimism under positive separation constraints and stronger neighborhood compression rewards for dense actions. Global edge count supplies inexpensive context, and every structural feature remains active in both regimes.

program.name: weighted_conflict_moments
program.rationale: Use weighted edge products to emphasize conflicts between valuable actions. These reduce to edge counts in the supplied unit examples, while neighborhood and residual packing summaries provide additional distinctions.

program.name: include_exclude_regret
program.rule: min(1, max(0, neighbor_lower / max(1e-9, abs(neighbor_upper)))) * (weight + include_lower - exclude_lower) + (1 - min(1, max(0, neighbor_lower / max(1e-9, abs(neighbor_upper))))) * (weight + include_upper - exclude_upper)
program.rationale: Compare forcing the action with dropping only that action. Neighborhood packing-to-cover agreement controls a mixture of feasible-packing regret and clique-cover regret.

program.name: boundary_release
program.rationale: Measure conflicts between excluded neighbors and surviving actions explicitly. Rewarding this released burden may distinguish equal local neighborhoods, with neighbor packing capacity balancing the cost of exclusion.

program.name: completion_opportunity_ratio
program.rationale: Rank estimated completion reward relative to displaced independent capacity. Residual packing losses retain global structural information, though the ratio may favor cheap exclusions too strongly.

program.name: include_exclude_bounds
program.rationale: Estimate inclusion advantage using polynomial lower and upper summaries of both branches. Deletion sensitivity adds distinctions beyond neighborhood density, although loose bounds may distort the ranking.

program.name: packing_sensitivity
program.rationale: Reward candidates whose forced completion improves on packing after deletion. Closed-neighborhood packing adds a local replacement signal, with edge summaries addressing externally different equality joins.

program.name: residual_envelope
program.rationale: Prioritize feasible residual reward, temper it with a cover envelope, and distinguish independent discarded alternatives from mutually conflicting neighbors.

program.name: density_capacity
program.rationale: Discount conflict mass when neighbors already conflict heavily with one another, then account for residual capacity and remaining conflict density.

program.name: cut_adjusted_completion
program.rationale: Cross-boundary conflicts may reveal useful relief from deleting the neighborhood, separating candidates whose degrees and local packing capacities coincide.

program.name: edge_removal_efficiency
program.rationale: Combine completion potential with weighted conflicts eliminated per blocked reward. The deletion cover estimates competing potential; removal efficiency may help under dense constraints but remains a heuristic.

program.name: cover_gap_switch
program.rationale: Compare packing-cover uncertainty in retained and discarded sets; use the residual cover when its gap is relatively small and the feasible packing otherwise.

program.name: closed_neighborhood_exchange
program.rationale: Open and closed neighborhood summaries offer different witnesses of the root-for-neighbors exchange, complementing residual completion estimates without exact optimization.

program.name: include_exclude_regret
program.rationale: Compare polynomial feasible proposals with the root included or excluded, using cover gaps and neighborhood structure to adjust estimated commitment regret.

program.name: interval_overlap
program.rationale: Use include and exclude packing-cover intervals to distinguish a robust exchange from an uncertain opportunity, with explicit penalties for wide intervals.

program.name: constraint_gap_risk
program.rationale: The paired temporal graphs motivate reducing optimism and increasing residual conflict pressure as constraint gaps grow, while retaining structural packing and cut information.

program.name: lower_completion
program.rule: weight + residual_pack - 0.25 * max(0, residual_cover - residual_pack) - 0.10 * max(0, neighbor_pack - weight) - 0.02 * max(0, neighbor_cover - neighbor_pack) + 0.01 * neighbor_edge_cost / max(1e-9, abs(weight + conflict_weight)) - 0.01 * residual_edge_cost / max(1e-9, abs(1 + compatible_weight))
program.rationale: Prioritize a feasible forced-root completion, discount completion uncertainty and packable blocked alternatives, and use edge costs as small structural corrections.

program.name: upper_capacity
program.rule: weight + residual_cover - 0.35 * max(0, residual_cover - residual_pack) - 0.15 * neighbor_cover + 0.05 * neighbor_pack + 0.01 * neighbor_product / max(1e-9, abs(1 + conflict_weight * conflict_weight)) - 0.01 * residual_product / max(1e-9, abs(1 + compatible_weight * compatible_weight))
program.rationale: Favor optimistic residual capacity that bounded repair might realize, while tempering loose covers, blocked capacity, and concentrated weighted conflicts.

program.name: local_exchange_efficiency
program.rule: weight / max(1e-9, abs(weight + neighbor_cover)) + 0.30 * (weight + residual_pack) / max(1e-9, abs(weight + residual_cover)) - 0.15 * max(0, neighbor_pack - weight) / max(1e-9, abs(weight + neighbor_pack)) + 0.05 * neighbor_edge_min / max(1e-9, abs(1 + conflict_weight)) - 0.02 * neighbor_edge_product / max(1e-9, abs(1 + conflict_weight * conflict_weight)) + 0.01 * weight / max(1e-9, abs(1 + degree))
program.rationale: Use reward per estimated blocked capacity as exchange efficiency, with residual completion reliability and neighborhood conflict redundancy as corrections.

program.name: conservative_branch_margin
program.rule: include_lb - exclude_ub + 0.20 * (include_ub - exclude_lb) - 0.02 * max(0, neighbor_pack - weight) - 0.01 * max(0, neighbor_cover - neighbor_pack)
program.rationale: Rank the conservative include-versus-exclude objective margin, supplemented by a smaller optimistic margin and local replacement-cost correction.

program.name: boundary_release
program.rule: weight + residual_pack - 0.20 * max(0, residual_cover - residual_pack) - 0.05 * (neighbor_pack + neighbor_cover) + 0.15 * boundary_min / max(1e-9, abs(1 + conflict_weight)) + 0.02 * boundary_product / max(1e-9, abs(1 + conflict_weight * compatible_weight))
program.rationale: Credit candidates whose removal of neighbors also removes substantial conflicts with the residual graph, while retaining completion and blocked-capacity estimates.

program.name: interval_dominance
program.rule: (2 + (include_lb - exclude_ub) / max(1e-9, abs(weight + conflict_weight)) if include_lb > exclude_ub else (-2 + (include_ub - exclude_lb) / max(1e-9, abs(weight + conflict_weight)) if include_ub < exclude_lb else (include_lb + include_ub - exclude_lb - exclude_ub) / max(1e-9, abs(1 + include_ub - include_lb + exclude_ub - exclude_lb)))) - 0.03 * max(0, neighbor_pack - weight) / max(1e-9, abs(weight + neighbor_cover))
program.rationale: Separate proven interval dominance from unresolved branches; rank overlapping intervals by their normalized midpoint advantage and blocked packing cost.

program.name: density_completion
program.rule: weight + min(residual_cover, max(residual_pack, compatible_weight * compatible_weight / max(1e-9, abs(compatible_weight + 2 * residual_edge_cost)))) - 0.20 * max(neighbor_pack, conflict_weight * conflict_weight / max(1e-9, abs(conflict_weight + 2 * neighbor_edge_cost))) - 0.05 * max(0, neighbor_cover - neighbor_pack)
program.rationale: A density-derived capacity surrogate may recover opportunities missed by greedy packing; clamp the residual estimate between packing and cover summaries. Its weighted extension is a hypothesis.

program.name: residual_blend
program.rationale: Favor feasible residual completion with modest optimism. Neighborhood packing and both edge counts supply distinctions beyond degree and neighborhood edge count alone.

program.name: cover_priority
program.rationale: Emphasize residual completion potential when a deterministic packing may be pessimistic. Independent neighborhood capacity estimates penalize displaced opportunities.

program.name: sparsity_capacity
program.rationale: Blend residual packing with a density-based capacity proxy motivated by the unit-weight examples. Omitting clique partitions tests a cheaper structural interface.

program.name: density_switch
program.rationale: Use packing mainly in sparse states and cover potential mainly in dense states. Active edge count supplies graph context for otherwise shared structural vectors.

program.name: displacement_ratio
program.rationale: Rank completion reward relative to estimated independent reward displaced in the neighborhood. This tests a stronger opportunity-cost penalty than additive scoring.

program.name: gap_adaptive_branch
program.rule: 0.5 * (include_lb - exclude_lb + include_ub - exclude_ub) - (0.10 + 0.25 * (station_gap + satellite_gap) / max(1e-9, abs(duration + station_gap + satellite_gap))) * (include_ub - include_lb + exclude_ub - exclude_lb) - (0.05 + 0.10 * (station_gap + satellite_gap) / max(1e-9, abs(duration + station_gap + satellite_gap))) * max(0, neighbor_pack - weight) + 0.03 * boundary_min / max(1e-9, abs(1 + conflict_weight))
program.rationale: Increase caution about branch uncertainty and blocked alternatives as switching gaps grow relative to duration, while crediting removed boundary conflicts.

program.name: gap_blend
program.rationale: Allow more residual optimism as temporal gaps tighten constraints. Residual edges distinguish equal local summaries, while active density scales the degree penalty.

program.name: uncertainty_discount
program.rationale: Discount residual optimism when neighborhood packing and cover estimates disagree. Both residual and neighborhood summaries remain demanded structural witnesses.

program.name: context_midpoint
program.rationale: Pool residual packing and cover into a midpoint estimate to make room for active graph context. Increase the clustering correction with density while retaining neighborhood opportunity costs.

program.name: opportunity_ratio
program.rationale: Replace raw degree cost with estimated independent neighborhood reward, then adjust for residual feasibility, neighbor overlap, and boundary competition.

program.name: completion_midpoint
program.rationale: Blend feasible residual packing with its clique-cover upper summary, discount mutually conflicting neighbors, and charge coupling between neighbors and the residual.

program.name: completion_risk
program.rationale: Prefer credible residual completions by penalizing packing-cover uncertainty and displaced neighborhood opportunity; boundary conflicts partly reduce that opportunity cost.

program.name: gap_adaptive
program.rule: weight + (0.8*r_pack+0.2*r_cover if station_gap+satellite_gap>0 else 0.6*r_pack+0.4*r_cover) - (0.6*n_pack+0.2*n_cover if station_gap+satellite_gap>0 else 0.2*n_pack+0.4*n_cover) + 0.1*n_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1+degree)) - 0.05*r_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1+remaining_count-degree)) + 0.05*weight/max(1e-9,abs(1+degree))
program.rationale: Use the supplied gap parameters to emphasize feasible packing under tightened constraints, with neighborhood and residual edge summaries distinguishing conflict arrangements.

program.name: boundary_release
program.rationale: Hypothesize that deleting neighbors with strong residual conflicts releases useful alternatives, while residual internal conflicts remain a completion burden.

program.name: clique_overlap
program.rationale: Favor roots whose neighbors offer little independent reward despite substantial overlap; penalize uncertain neighborhood opportunity and reward feasible residual completion.

program.name: closed_neighborhood_regret
program.rationale: Combine include-versus-exclude feasible packing contrast with the root's local contribution to closed-neighborhood packing and asymmetric cover uncertainty corrections.

program.name: forced_lower_cut
program.rule: weight + residual_pack - 0.15*max(0, neighbor_pack-weight) - (0.05+0.05*(station_gap+satellite_gap)/max(1e-9, abs(duration+station_gap+satellite_gap)))*max(0, residual_cover-residual_pack) - 0.05*max(0, neighbor_cover-neighbor_pack) + 0.10*min(neighbor_pack, cut_weight/max(1e-9, abs(1+compatible_weight))) - 0.01*residual_edges/max(1e-9, abs(1+compatible_weight))
program.rationale: Prioritize feasible reward after forcing root, penalize uncertain residual and neighborhood opportunities, and discount discarded neighbors that also conflict with the residual.

program.name: residual_interval
program.rationale: Use midpoint reward estimates with corrections for mutually conflicting neighbors and their external conflicts; stronger temporal gaps increase the external-conflict discount.

program.name: exclusion_contrast
program.rationale: Contrast polynomial include and exclude summaries to estimate the root's marginal value, with overlap and boundary corrections for structurally similar alternatives.

program.name: edge_relaxed_reward
program.rationale: Blend feasible residual reward with an edge-density surrogate clipped by the cover bound. This may stabilize packing-order sensitivity while retaining neighborhood opportunity costs.

program.name: closed_swap_discount
program.rule: weight + residual_pack - max(0, closed_pack-weight)*max(0, 1-min(1, cut_weight/max(1e-9, abs(1+conflict_weight+compatible_weight)))) - 0.15*max(0, residual_cover-residual_pack) - 0.1*max(0, closed_cover-closed_pack) + 0.05*neighbor_edges/max(1e-9, abs(1+degree))
program.rationale: Estimate the reward sacrificed by replacing a closed-neighborhood packing with root, discount that sacrifice when alternatives burden the residual, and penalize loose bounds.

program.name: include_exclude_regret
program.rationale: Combine pessimistic and optimistic inclusion-versus-exclusion margins, reducing optimism as temporal gaps grow and correcting local opportunity cost for external conflicts.

program.name: simplicial_scarcity
program.rationale: Favor roots whose reward dominates a cover bound on all neighbors, permitting a safe local exchange. Otherwise use residual reward and conflict redundancy with gap-sensitive discounting.

program.name: relative_force_yield
program.rationale: Rank forced reward relative to exclusion opportunity, with local efficiency corrections. Ratios may transfer across active-set sizes better than absolute reward margins.

program.name: active_reference_regret
program.rule: weight + residual_pack - 0.75*max(0, active_pack-weight-residual_cover) - 0.25*max(0, exclude_cover-weight-residual_pack) + 0.15*(weight+residual_cover-exclude_pack)/max(1e-9, abs(1+active_cover-active_pack)) - 0.05*max(0, residual_cover-residual_pack)
program.rationale: Penalize forced-cover deficits below a feasible active-graph reference and cautious inclusion-versus-exclusion regret; damp optimistic margins when the active graph has loose bounds.
